data.one_liner: Highlight text at the character-level for simple search term highlighting.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that highlights specific substrings or search terms within a longer text string. Supports case-insensitive matches, custom text styles for highlighted and non-highlighted portions, and basic overflow options.
use_when: You need to highlight search terms inside search results or lists
You want character-level or substring matching inside a Flutter Text widget
avoid_when: You need the highlighted text to be interactive or clickable
You require complex markdown or rich-text parsing beyond basic search term highlighting
strengths: Simple and lightweight widget for search term highlighting
Supports customizable text styles for matches and non-matches
Supports multiple search terms and case-sensitive options
weaknesses: Ancestor widget must have textDirection set explicitly or via MaterialApp
data.minimal_example:
SubstringHighlight(
  text: dropDownItem,
  term: searchTerm,
  textStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
  textStyleHighlight: TextStyle(color: Colors.black, decoration: TextDecoration.underline),
)
